question: What enduring nature and protective role does the goddess have toward the Aśvins?
premises: The goddess removes the agitation of the Aśvins.
The goddess has her essence present in the world of the Aśvins.
inference: The goddess is an eternal presence who protects the Aśvins and pervades their realm.
plain_english: She removes the Aśvins' agitation, is eternal, and has her essence abiding in the world of the Aśvins.
